notes: The source URL and text are the Accounting Associate of Arts Degree page; the Accounting Certificate of Achievement appears only as a link in the navigation menu, and its own requirements are not printed in the text, so no blocks were recorded for the certificate.

The A.A. section lists required courses totaling 27 units (ACCT 047 3, ACCT 200 4, ACCT 201 4, BUSAD 100 3, BUSAD 210 3, ECON 208 4 or STAT C1000/C1000H, ECON C2001 3 or C2001H, ECON C2002 3 or C2002H) and recommended courses ACCT 030, ACCT 090, CIT 101, CIT 114, MATH 102. These match the closed list exactly, so the certificate may share the same requirements; a reviewer should check the certificate's own page.

The A.A. page prints seven program learning outcomes and names entry-level jobs (accounting clerk, accounts payable/receivable clerk, claims clerk, payroll clerk, credit clerk, bookkeeper, accounting intern, tax preparer); they are written for the A.A. degree and were not recorded for the certificate.
The A.A. requires Cal-GETC or SBVC GE; not applicable to the certificate.
